verdict.rationale: PlanetScale documents recurring automation for its self-improving database agent — "Agents can review production Insights data and Schema Recommendations, then open pull requests with performance improvements — on a recurring schedule" (docs-31, docs-20, docs-42), and separately supports scheduled daily backups (docs-12, docs-33). However this is narrow, product-specific automation (performance-tuning agent and backup scheduling) rather than a general-purpose recurring job/workflow scheduler for arbitrary AI-native tasks. Missing for 10: a general-purpose job/workflow scheduler API or cron-like primitive usable for arbitrary agent tasks, and independent/hands-on confirmation that the recurring agent actually runs on schedule.
